seo.title: Already Home
seo.description: Interactive experience for Team Wonder and the 2026 World Cup, turning personal stories across the US into a visual canvas.

acf.description:
A digital platform created for Team Wonder around the 2026 World Cup, turning personal stories from across the US into a collective visual experience. Each story becomes a unique representation within an interactive 2D canvas, shaped by the people, places, and emotions behind it.

A collaboration with DDS, with development spanning the complete front-end and back-end, the interactive canvas, and OpenAI integration for story generation and transcription.

seo.title: Google Cloud x Team USA 🇺🇸
seo.description: AI-powered training platform developed with Google Cloud for Team USA, turning video footage into performance data.

acf.description:
An AI-powered training tool developed with Google Cloud for Team USA ahead of the Olympic Winter Games.

Designed for elite skiers and snowboarders, the platform transforms video footage into performance data, helping athletes and coaches analyse movement and better understand every phase of a trick.

A collaboration with Feels Like, with development focused on the complete interface and the integration of AI-generated data into interactive 3D overlays and visualisations.

seo.title: Forever Frequencies
seo.description: AI-powered interactive installation for the Barbican Centre, turning visitors’ future memories into unique generative music.

acf.description:
An AI-powered interactive installation for the Barbican Centre in London.

Visitors imagined a future memory through a series of questions, transforming their answers into a unique AI-generated melody played by a mechanical music box — a “Forever Frequency” connecting memory, music, and generative technology.

A collaboration with DDS, with development covering the tablet experience and OSC integration with the music box and lighting.
